name: Patterns of Judgment
title: Predicting Partially Masked Judicial Votes
context: European Court of Human Rights / Data Science Capstone (ISTE 470) / Rochester Institute of Technology
description: What can a group reveal about an unseen decision? A study of 10,000 judicial ballots, using procedural rules and voting coalitions to reconstruct masked votes and explore how patterns travel across borders.
highlights: Models each panel as a connected whole, reconstructing individual votes from a shared outcome and patterns of dissent.
Examines how judicial tendencies, national allegiance, and procedural language shape collective decisions.
Explores generalization to unseen respondent countries through country-held-out evaluation, with a Python pipeline and IEEE research paper.
